historicalBaseline.note: The prior independent ten-item NO-GO remains historical evidence. This report is the implementation owner's closure claim, not an independent GO.

priorFailedAttempts.failure: The Trivy action ref omitted the required v tag prefix.
priorFailedAttempts.disposition: Corrected to aquasecurity/trivy-action@v0.32.0; the failed tag may be replaced only after registry, GHCR and GitHub Release identities are independently confirmed unused.

priorFailedAttempts.stage: real PostgreSQL and isolated Golden Stack Worker preflight
priorFailedAttempts.failure: Linux bind-mount files were owned by the host runner and inaccessible to the named non-root sandbox user.
priorFailedAttempts.disposition: The sandbox retains its image-declared non-root user, uses the Worker's private numeric group, and grants materialized paths group-only access; real Golden Stack acceptance passed after the fix.

priorFailedAttempts.stage: isolated Golden Stack cleanup after all required checks passed
priorFailedAttempts.failure: PostgreSQL initdb correctly reset its private data directory to mode 0700, preventing the host runner from deleting the retained workspace.
priorFailedAttempts.disposition: Before container removal, the same non-root sandbox user now restores group rwX only on entries it owns; source files and paths outside that single workspace are excluded.

priorFailedAttempts.failure: PostgreSQL correctly created postgres.log with owner-only permissions, so the host Worker could not collect the optional expected artifact before sandbox teardown.
priorFailedAttempts.disposition: The non-root sandbox user now grants its private host group access after each command and immediately before artifact collection, while excluding symlinks and retaining a mode-0700 host root. The real Golden Stack passed after the fix.

priorFailedAttempts.stage: real generated Next.js, FastAPI and PostgreSQL Docker Compose preflight
priorFailedAttempts.failure: The services and health checks passed, but Docker Compose emitted one JSON object for the migration service while the exit assertion assumed an array.
priorFailedAttempts.disposition: The gate now normalizes both supported object and array JSON shapes, still requires exactly one migration service, verifies its identity and requires ExitCode 0. The exact Compose gate passed locally after the fix.

priorFailedAttempts.stage: Trivy setup before the first source vulnerability scan
priorFailedAttempts.failure: trivy-action v0.32.0 attempted to install its retired default Trivy v0.64.1 release and exited before scanning; no vulnerability result was produced.
priorFailedAttempts.disposition: All seven source, preflight-image and registry-image scans now pin official trivy-action v0.36.0 by immutable tag SHA; its Trivy v0.70.0 source scan completed locally with zero HIGH and zero CRITICAL findings. Scan severities and fail-closed exit codes are unchanged.

Strict /v1/verifications create/get/stream/retry/cancel plus runtime response validation.
Verified RS256 workload principal binding, exact keys and identity tuple, decimal cursor, terminal EOF tests.
No caller command/cwd/env/credential surface; exact server profile with immutable image and canonical digest.
Real concurrent migration, queue/outbox, lease, fencing, checkpoint, duplicate-delivery and restart tests.

Real Evidence creation/verification and independent digest/integrity recomputation on store resolution and client receipt.
Non-root migrate/api/worker targets; release workflow publishes and verifies exact amd64/arm64 manifests.
Next.js/FastAPI/PostgreSQL Golden Stack passes isolated Docker and real Compose acceptance.
